column1: # Corpus files that pass the default lint run and for which the provider lists NOTHING to any of the
# stranger subjects of PolicyLintCorpusTest (remote hosts, a file share, a local directory elsewhere,
# every principal kind).  Tab separated: file, why.  The cross-check requires every other clean file to
# list at least one permission, and these to list none: a provider that lists nothing at all, or one that
# starts to list something here, fails the test.
